Boost your play Max 7300 MB/s Read Up to 7,300 MB/s read speed 1 reaching the limits of PCIe ® 4.0 data bandwidth, shortens load times when fast travel and entering dungeons in huge maps of MMORPGs and open-world/sandbox games. Max 1000K IOPS Read Random read performance of up to 1,000,000 IOPS 1 reduces gameplay annoyances such as lags and slowdowns by delivering powerful processing performance for heavy graphics rendering, allowing players to experience a smooth and immersive gaming tempo. Max 2GB DDR4 DRAM Up to 2 GB 1 of DDR4 DRAM boosts performance by storing fast-accessing data in DRAM instead of NAND. It also reduces the number of direct accesses to NAND, which consequently extends the life of the SSD. power and endurance G Series NVMe™ SSD is rated the drive with an endurance of up to 10,000 TBW (for NE1N8TB) 2 and 1,600,000 hours of MTBF 3 . The synergy of flash management technology improves both performance and memory life. Dynamic SLC Caching Stores cache size up to 1/3 of the total memory capacity of the SSD ― this contributes to a longer life by reducing the workload on the NAND while speeding up the transfer of frequently accessed data. Advanced wear-leveling Advanced wear-leveling algorithms efficiently and evenly distribute data write/erase cycles to each area of the NAND flash memory: contribute not only to improving performance but to extending the life of TLC NAND. LDPC The controller is equipped with LDPC (Low-Density Parity Check) ECC algorithm, which detects and corrects reading errors with high accuracy, and protects from data corruption caused by the aging of flash memory cells. Play without worry Quality tested In addition to general functional examinations, This product is Read/Write tested before shipment at higher temperatures specified by Nextorage. 5-year limited warranty Warranty valid for 5 years from the original date of purchase or before writing the maximum TBW (Total Bytes Written.) Compatibility ・Compatible with computers equipped with an M.2 (M Key) port supporting the M.2 2280 form factor. ・Supports PCIe 4.0 standard and NVMe protocol. Exclusive Offer for Nextorage SSD Purchasers SSD Suite for Nextorage Utility Software for Managing OS and Data Migration, and Monitoring the Health of Your SSD SSD Suite for Nextorage is a software product designed to support the migration of your OS and data from your current SSD to your newly purchased Nextorage SSD, enabling its use as a boot drive. It also allows you to manage the health of your SSD, securely delete data, update firmware, and more. The software can be used once it detects and activates the Nextorage SSD.
